description: This Java source file defines the class PhotoDecodeRunnable, which implements Runnable and handles decoding a byte array into a Bitmap image in a background thread. It is used within an Android project to decode images asynchronously, with methods for handling decode states and communicating with a parent task object.

classes.name: PhotoDecodeRunnable
classes.description: A runnable class for decoding image byte arrays into Bitmap objects asynchronously in an Android application. It manages decoding retries, handles memory errors, and communicates decode status back to the parent task.

methods.name: PhotoDecodeRunnable
methods.description: Constructor that takes a TaskRunnableDecodeMethods object which provides callbacks and shared data for decoding.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the decoding process on a separate thread, including handling decoding attempts, potential memory issues, and updating the parent task with decode states.
